scope: Pinned C# source review for concrete native account/auth/ban/progression/purchase state writes, credential sinks, and deletion paths. No account data inspected.

findings.classification: vanilla persisted onboarding and consent UI
findings.evidence: Reads, lowers and later restores LastAcceptedPrivacyPolicyVersion; saves Player data; replaces accept listeners and hides ManageData.
Host sets QuickChatOnly to FreeChatOrQuickChat; entire single source callback is excluded, including its additional chat visual changes.
Sets canOnline true for mod-debugger or missing mod consent. Bundled updater notice path is also excluded.
Sets DataManager.Player.Ban.banPoints to zero before original online-permission check.
Writes AlwaysShowMinPlayerWarning and ViewedMinPlayerWarning and calls Player.Save; distinct GameStartManager.Start callback is retained.

findings.classification: real authentication credential forwarded to optional third party
findings.action: remove optional producer; unavailable false text option
findings.evidence: POST lobby_created adds Authorization Bearer EOSManager.Instance.UserIDToken. Server response room token is a separate EHR service capability used for update_status and logged. All those producer/parser/token paths are removed in protected directory body.

findings.classification: optional website verification, ordinary account identifiers
findings.action: preserve command recognition; local unavailable response
findings.evidence: Original submits user-provided nonce UUID plus friend_code, ProductUserId and game_id. Does not authenticate the official game. Protected body makes no request.

findings.action: preserve command recognition; protected informational response
findings.evidence: Original parses 1..999 then calls player.RpcSetLevel(number - 1). Only this command body changes. Persistent XP write was not established by that RPC alone; ordinary game XP remains unchanged.

findings.classification: no active grant in this pinned source
findings.evidence: ClickCount is const zero; active prefix guard returns true. Apparent __result=true and return=false are comments. Descriptor EHR.PlayerPurchasesDataPatch::Prefix#331, selector 42e8132f1a70a4b96206.

findings.classification: EHR-only local/remote achievements with ordinary derived player identifier
findings.action: retain; distinguish from vanilla XP and credentials
findings.evidence: Local EHR_DATA/Achievements.json. Upload DTO userId is GetHashedPuid(), first five plus final four SHA256 hex characters of ProductUserId; achievements are EHR.CompletedAchievements. GET uses same userId. No EOS/authentication credential in DTO.

findings.classification: original NativeAOT DTO for same EHR-only request
findings.evidence: EHR.SourcePort.AchievementUploadRequest has string userId and HashSet<Achievements.Type> achievements. JSON adapter preserves original GetHashedPuid local userId dataflow; corroborated by owning adapter agent.

findings.classification: ordinary friend/PUID identifiers on EHR preset upload
findings.evidence: User preset upload includes friend_code and ProductUserId; no EOS token or Authorization credential. These are player-related identifiers, not authentication secrets.

findings.classification: own host moderation lists and kick policy
findings.action: retain; distinguish from native account ban state
findings.evidence: EHR ban/EAC files and temporary whitelist are host-side moderation; not DataManager.Player.Ban.banPoints.

findings.classification: old mod data and updater files
findings.action: audit only; updater separately adapted by parent
findings.evidence: Old TOH_DATA removal conditional on EHR_DATA/BanWords existing; cleanup of EHR DLL backups/temp files in mod directory. No vanilla game-save path observed in these calls.

findings.action: retain scoped behavior; distinguish from account data deletion
findings.evidence: Targets exact rooted EHR_Logs basename; first dry-run, then explicit user confirmation before deletion. Does not select vanilla save directories.
Creates unique GUID temporary font file under Application.temporaryCachePath and deletes that file.
Hides AccountWindow; decorates friend-code display and hides request UI. No provider replacement, credential mutation, XP reset or save write established from these presentation changes.

limitations: Source findings do not prove server enforcement behavior or absence of account risk.
Full-source build, hook activation and physical-device playtesting are separate integration gates.
EHR achievements and preset services still carry ordinary player-related identifiers; narrow policy does not silently remove them.
